100% of crude/refined product export proceeds flow directly into offshore collection accounts; debt service for international Eurobonds is deducted prior to any fiscal repatriation.
Low cash lifting cost ($8 - $18/boe) ensures robust operating profitability and positive cash flow even during severe oil price downturns ($50/bbl).
Proved plus probable commercial reserves provide a durable 12-18 year production life, underpinning long-dated senior paper.

verdict.stance: Neutral / Sovereign-Capped Romanian Gas Producer Funding Neptun Deep (BBB-)
verdict.summary: Romgaz reported 9M26 total income of RON 6.36bn (-2.3% YoY), EBITDA of RON 2.85bn (-14.1%), and net profit of RON 2.22bn as regulated gas prices softened while Neptun Deep capex ramped (liabilities rose to RON 8.75bn vs RON 6.25bn YE25 cash). Credit remains capped by Romania's BBB- sovereign rating.

positives: Very conservative starting leverage (~0.65x) and high ~39% net margin (9M26 NPAT RON 2,217.7m on RON 5,700.6m revenue).
50% partner with OMV Petrom in transformational Neptun Deep Black Sea gas project (~100 bcm recoverable).
Fitch BBB- IG rating and €1.5bn EMTN programme (€500m 4.75% Oct-2029 notes >10x oversubscribed, XS2914558593).
negatives: Multi-year Neptun Deep capex peak (~€2bn Romgaz share) will push net leverage higher through 2027 first gas.
Romanian regulated gas price caps and windfall taxation overhang.

background.business_overview: Romania's largest natural gas producer and underground gas storage operator, 70% state-owned (BVB: SNG).
background.asset_perimeter: Onshore mature gas fields, Depogaz storage, Iernut CCGT, and 50% stake in Black Sea Neptun Deep.
background.ownership_governance: 70% owned by Romanian Ministry of Energy; listed on BVB and dual-listed bond on LuxSE/BVB.
